subject: math
l2: 曲面积分与高斯斯托克斯
question: 证明一个薄的均匀的球壳对一个在球外的质点产生的引力，相当于这个球壳的质量全部集中于它的几何中心时所产生的引力.
answer: S = \iint_ {D} \frac {G (R \cos \theta - a)}{\left[ R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta \right] ^ {3 / 2}} R ^ {2} \sin \

steps.text: 分析 只需计算球壳对质点的引力，再验证结果。为便于计算，可设球心为原点，质点在某坐标轴上。
设球面的方程为 $\Sigma: x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = R^2$ ，单位质点在 $z$ 轴上，其坐标为 $(0, 0, a) (a > R)$ 。设球壳对质点的引力为 $F = (F_x, F_y, F_z)$ ，由对称性，知 $F_x = F_y = 0$ ，利用球面坐标，有

$$
\Sigma : \left\{ \begin{array}{l} x = R \sin \theta \cos \varphi \\ y = R \sin \theta \sin \varphi (0 \leqslant \theta \leqslant \pi , 0 \leqslant \varphi \leqslant 2 \pi), \quad \mathrm{d} S = R ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm{d} \theta \mathrm{d} \varphi . \\ z = R \cos \theta \end{array} \right.

\begin{array}{r l} & {F _ {z} = \iint_ {\Sigma} \frac {G (z - a)}{\left[ x ^ {2} + y ^ {2} - (z - a) ^ {2} \right] ^ {3 / 2}} \mathrm{d} S = \iint_ {D} \frac {G (R \cos \theta - a)}{\left[ R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta \right] ^ {3 / 2}} R ^ {2} \sin \theta \mathrm{d} \theta \mathrm{d} \varphi} \\ & {\quad = - G R ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {2 \pi} \mathrm{d} \varphi \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \frac {(R \cos \theta - a)}{\left[ R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta \right] ^ {3 / 2}} \mathrm{d} \cos \theta} \\ & {\quad = - G \frac {2 \pi R}{a} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} (R \cos \theta - a) \mathrm{d} [ R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta ] ^ {- 1 / 2}} \\ & {\quad = - G \frac {2 \pi R}{a} \Bigg [ (R \cos \theta - a) (R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta) ^ {- 1 / 2} ] _ {0} ^ {\pi} - \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} [ R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta ] ^ {- 1 / 2}   \mathrm{d} (R \cos \theta - a) \Bigg ]} \\ & {\quad = - G \frac {2 \pi R}{a} \Bigg [ 0 + \frac {1}{2 a} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} [ R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta ] ^ {- 1 / 2}   \mathrm{d} (R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta) \Bigg ]} \\ & {\quad = - G \frac {2 \pi R}{a ^ {2}} [ R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta ] ^ {1 / 2}   | _ {0} ^ {\pi} = - G \frac {4 \pi R ^ {2}}{a ^ {2}} (G   \text {为引力系数，负号表示引力的方向}).} \end{array}
$$

solution.final_answer: S = \iint_ {D} \frac {G (R \cos \theta - a)}{\left[ R ^ {2} + a ^ {2} - 2 a R \cos \theta \right] ^ {3 / 2}} R ^ {2} \sin \

meta.commentary: 评注 若该题用直角坐标系计算，则较为困难。一是直角坐标系中球面必须要分块才便于写出曲面的显函数方程；二是积分计算也相对困难。对大于半球的球冠都适宜选球面坐标系计算积分。
